- Initial release of AI-powered pet grooming effect assessment.
- Detects mat residue area, dandruff coverage, and coat smoothness from post-grooming images or videos.
- Generates a 0-100 grooming score with specific re-grooming suggestions.
- Supports history report queries with strict open-id verification and standardized output in Markdown table format.
- Designed for home grooming, pet salon quality checks, and shedding season management for cats and dogs.
